1957, March 14
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten and typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. BONAVENTURE MONASTERY Capuchin Fathers 1740 MT. ELLIOTT AVENUE. DETROIT 7, MICHIGAN
Blessed be God in all His designs!
March 14, 1957
God bless you my Dear Rt. Rev. Brother Edw'd.
Thanks be to God! In receiving no news yesterday -- from Margaret and Frank, we were confirmed in our confidence and in God that He would surprise the doctors in regard to her threatening carcinoma operation. I hope that all her friends may -- grateful to God offer a few holy communions in earnest thanksgiving.
How wonder -- in all His designs with all who confide in Him. How fortunite! -- How humbly grateful we ought to be!
Deo Gratias! A Million!
(other side typed as follows)
Thanks be to God, though comparatively unnoted and quiet God granted us the gracious privilege to celebrate a happy diamond jubilee in the Order and in the holy habit if Saint Frances.
This took place Monday, January 14, at solemn high Mass. I would hardly know how it could have been more beautiful, under the simple circumstances. ... I had come to the holy novitiate Christmas Eve. and six months ahead of the seven other students who joined me the following July. They are all gone on to Heaven now, we hope, with their senior of all, Father Damasus, in his 90th year. Had he waited five months longer he and I would have had golden jubilee together. He was patient and joyful to the last. May he be privileged to await in the peace of the saints, the inconceivable glory of the Gen. Ressurection. Pl. pardon the digresxion: To-day Deo Gratias, it is sixty years and sixty days I was invested.
It was probably my fault that the cdldbfzgion (celebration) (unfinished)
